issues.description: Method getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): the UML in problem_statement.md declares the method as returning int, while the template's TODO comment and the solution implementation indicate a double return type. Specifically, problem_statement.md shows '+getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): int' (line 72), the template Lecture.java contains a TODO comment 'Return type: double for precise calculation' (line 17), and the solution Lecture.java defines 'public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor()' (line 85). This inconsistency will confuse students about the expected return type and can cause failing tests or signature mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the expected return type consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: update the UML and textual description in problem_statement.md to declare getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double (and mention that a double is used for a precise calculation), and update any tests or examples to expect a double. Alternatively, if an integer result is desired, change the template comment and the solution implementation to return int and update the implementation accordingly. Ensure the README/UML, template TODOs, solution, and tests all use the same return type.
